news.headline: Intuit Reports Fiscal Q1 2027 Results and Updates Full-Year Guidance
news.summary: Intuit reported fiscal first-quarter earnings that exceeded analyst expectations while simultaneously lowering its revenue outlook for the full 2027 fiscal year.

news.headline: Intuit Enters Agreement to Sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons
news.summary: Intuit has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Mailchimp business to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion.

news.headline: Meta Warns of China-Linked Accounts Targeting Taiwan Elections on Threads
news.summary: Meta Platforms has issued warnings regarding the use of its Threads platform by China-linked accounts attempting to influence local elections in Taiwan.

news.headline: Meta Platforms CFO Executes Insider Share Sale
news.summary: Meta Platforms Chief Financial Officer Susan J. Li sold 9,196 shares of company stock for approximately $5.72 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

news.headline: Meta Reevaluating 2030 Net Zero Emissions Goal
news.summary: Meta is reconsidering its 2030 net zero emissions target, citing the significant energy demands of its ongoing artificial intelligence infrastructure buildout.

news.headline: DZ Bank Adjusts Price Target on Palantir Technologies to $220 From $210
news.summary: DZ Bank has revised its price target for Palantir Technologies, increasing it from $210 to $220.

news.headline: Russian Espionage Case Involves Palantir Employees
news.summary: A Russian national has been indicted on charges related to a scheme to gather intelligence on employees of a technology and defense company, identified by reports as Palantir.
